The four-issue series was written by [[Michael Moreci]], illustrated by [[Reese Hannigan]], [[Elisabetta D'Amico]], and [[Michael Atiyeh]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The [[Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch—Rogue Agents 1|first issue]] was released on [[December 31]], [[2025]].
